unit cell actually increases the energy slightly as com-

Future work will aim to extend the current method to
accommodate a broader range of coil geometries. Very com-
plex shapes, such as concave sections or winding paths loop-
ing through openings, would require the development of
new robotic winding techniques. While the winding method
described here only requires the positioner and a single articu-
lated robot, these advanced techniques may involve the second
articulated robot in our setup, using a dedicated tool to support
the process.
